title: Ramblin' Rose RV Park
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: The Ramblin Rose RV Park is located in Santa Rose, New Mexico and is perfect for travelers passing through town and looking for a quiet, clean and well-managed place to spend a few nights. The park is along Historic Route 66 so there are a few great craft and souvenir shops, as well as local restaurants that truly reflect the culture and vibe of Santa Rosa.
